O ka sefa mabala otlhe a a rulagantsweng ka maina le boleng jwa one. Sekai: Field1 == Value1. Fa mabala kgotsa boleng di na le dikgala, di tsenye mo matshwaong a nopolo a le mangwe. Sekai: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Dirisa backslash go tlola tlhaka e e laolang. Sekai: Field1 == I'm. O ka kopanya maemo a mantsi. Sekai: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Diopereitara di tlhalosiwa go tswa molemeng go ya mojeng; fetola thulaganyo ka masakana. Sekai: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). O ka batla mabala a mokwalo ka regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

globalSearch-instructions-description: Dipatlisiso ka kgona include badiri go refine batla. Badiri di e tlhalositswe ka writing modiri leina le boleng kgaogantswe ka e colon. Go sekai, e modiri specification ya `lenaane:E thibetswe` would tekanyetso batla go dikarata seo di contained mo e lenaane named *E thibetswe*. Fa boleng e na le dibaka kgotsa special ditlhaka sona tshwanetse nna enclosed mo quotation marks (e.g. `__operator_list__:"Go Review"`).

Placing e `-` mo front ya *<field>* dipatlisiso go absence ya e boleng mo seo lefelo (e.g. `e na le:-bofelo` dipatlisiso go dikarata ntle le e letlha la bofelo).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - kwa *<sort-name>* ke nngwe ya `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` kgotsa `__predicate_modified__`. Go e descending rulaganya, place e `-` mo front ya rulaganya leina.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - kwa *<n>* ke e e siameng integer expressing palo ya dikarata go nna displayed ka nngwe tsebe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Multiple badiri ka nna e tlhalositswe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Similar badiri di *OR*ed together. Dikarata seo tshwantsha le fa e le efe ya conditions tla nna returned.
`__operator_list__:E teng __operator_list__:E thibetswe` would return dikarata contained mo le fa e le efe lenaane named *E thibetswe* kgotsa *E teng*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Differing badiri di *AND*ed together. Fela dikarata seo tshwantsha tsotlhe ya differing badiri di returned. `__operator_list__:E teng __operator_label__:red` returns fela dikarata mo lenaane *E teng* ka e *red* letshwao.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Malatsi ka kgona nna e tlhalositswe jaaka e e siameng kgotsa negative integer kgotsa using `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` kgotsa `__predicate_year__` go ya jaanong period.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Ka ya tlwaelo e bolokilweng dikarata di ga searched.

sandstorm-migration-description: Fa WeKan runs mo teng e Sandstorm grain, ya sona kgale MongoDB 3 polokelotshedimosetso ke e hudusitswe go FerretDB v1 (SQLite) mo ntlha launch, le dilo tse di tshwaraganeng le ditshwantsho tsa batho di e sutisitswe go tswa polokelotshedimosetso go grain's difaele/dilo tse di tshwaraganeng le difaele/ditshwantsho tsa batho directories. Eno bontsha whether seo khuduso succeeded le how much disiki sebaka kgale e e sa baakanngwang MongoDB polokelotshedimosetso difaele sa ntse dirisa mo teng grain, le lets wena phimola tseo e e sa baakanngwang difaele go mahala sebaka.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb: E e sa baakanngwang MongoDB 3 polokelotshedimosetso difaele
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Phimola e e sa baakanngwang MongoDB polokelotshedimosetso difaele
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Morago e successful khuduso tshedimosetso lives mo FerretDB le mo tsamaiso ya difaele, jalo kgale e e sa baakanngwang MongoDB 3 polokelotshedimosetso difaele ka kgona nna e phimotswe go mahala grain disiki sebaka. Seno ga se ka ke sa dirololwa.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Phimola e e sa baakanngwang MongoDB 3 polokelotshedimosetso difaele go mahala disiki sebaka? tshedimosetso e na le setse nnile e hudusitswe go FerretDB le tsamaiso ya difaele. Seno ga se ka ke sa dirololwa.

cards-loading-auto: Ya boitiriso (bonya fela go big diboto)
cards-loading-description: WeKan loads boto dikarata ka boitiriso: e big boto (over bogolo threshold) loads fela dikarata currently bonalang (infinite scroll) plus e live palo, jalo sona stays fast le e dirisa less segopotso le bandwidth, fa smaller diboto laisa nngwe le nngwe karata go simplest, fully featured experience. Foo ke ga go sepe go configure. Badiri ka kgona sa ntse pateletsa e mokgwa ka CARDS_LOADING (tsotlhe/bonya/auto) le CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD environment variables.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Bonya karata e a laisa ke experimental: karata counters le WIP ditekanyetso di accurate, but Calendar/Table/Gantt views le multi-select reflect fela dikarata loaded jalo far. Reload bula diboto morago changing eno.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Fa e tshubilwe, tsotlhe dikgokagano (both Markdown dikgokagano jaaka [letshwao](url) le e e sa baakanngwang HTML <a href> ditshwao) di ka metlha bontshitswe jaaka tlwaelegileng, non-clickable mokwalwa mo nngwe le nngwe rich mokwalwa lefelo (boto le karata ditlhogo, ditlhaloso, ditlhaloso, checklists, etc.). Eno prevents misleading e e ka tobetswang dikgokagano. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe, jalo dikgokagano stay e e ka tobetswang.
always-show-code-as-text: Ka metlha bontsha tsotlhe khoutu jaaka tlwaelegileng mokwalwa
always-show-code-as-text-description: Fa e tshubilwe, rich mokwalwa ke le ka motlha rendered jaaka Markdown kgotsa HTML: entire motswedi ke ka metlha bontshitswe jaaka tlwaelegileng mokwalwa mo nngwe le nngwe rich mokwalwa lefelo (boto le karata ditlhogo, ditlhaloso, ditlhaloso, checklists, etc.). Eno reveals e fitlhilwe diteng — HTML ditlhaloso (<!-- -->), target ya Markdown dikgokagano, JavaScript le le fa e le efe nngwe khoutu — jalo tsotlhe khoutu ke ka metlha bonalang, ga e e ka tobetswang, le ga e a tsamaya. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe, jalo Markdown ke rendered normally.
disable-all-import-description: Fa e tshubilwe, tsotlhe tlisa features di turned timilwe: go tlisa e boto go tswa WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea le Forgejo, jaaka well jaaka cloning e boto. tlisa menu options di e fitlhilwe le seabi rejects le fa e le efe tlisa kopo. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-all-export-description: Fa e tshubilwe, tsotlhe romelela kwa ntle features di turned timilwe: go romelela kwa ntle e boto jaaka WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, kgotsa go NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, le single-attachment romelela kwa ntle. romelela kwa ntle menu options di e fitlhilwe le seabi rejects le fa e le efe romelela kwa ntle kopo. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-import-avatars-description: Fa e tshubilwe, ditshwantsho tsa batho (modirisi profile pictures) di le ka motlha e tlisitswe. Eno covers WeKan JSON tlisa, Trello tlisa, le setshwantsho sa motho rulaganya mmogo go tswa external identity providers mo go tsena (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Names le nngwe tshedimosetso di sa ntse e tlisitswe; fela ditshwantsho tsa batho di skipped. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-export-avatars: Tima romelela kwa ntle ditshwantsho tsa batho
disable-export-avatars-description: Fa e tshubilwe, ditshwantsho tsa batho (modirisi profile pictures) di le ka motlha included fa go romelela kwa ntle e boto (WeKan JSON le CSV romelela kwa ntle). Usernames le nngwe tshedimosetso di sa ntse e rometswe kwa ntle; fela ditshwantsho tsa batho di omitted. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
anonymize-import-users-description: Fa e tshubilwe, go tlisa e WeKan JSON boto emisetsa nngwe le nngwe e tlisitswe user's leina la modirisi, tletse leina le initials ka sebaledi placeholders (modirisi1, modirisi2,...), drops tsa bone setshwantsho sa motho, le rewrites @leina la modirisi mentions (le requested-by / assigned-by mafelo) mo teng e tlisitswe karata le tlhaloso diteng. Nnyaa real modirisi identity go tswa motswedi boto ke e bolokilwe. word "modirisi" e latela puo ya motho go tlisa. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
anonymize-export-users-description: Fa e tshubilwe, go romelela kwa ntle e boto emisetsa nngwe le nngwe e rometswe kwa ntle user's leina la modirisi, tletse leina le initials ka sebaledi placeholders (modirisi1, modirisi2,...), drops tsa bone setshwantsho sa motho, le rewrites @leina la modirisi mentions (le requested-by / assigned-by mafelo) mo teng karata le tlhaloso diteng. e rometswe kwa ntle faele carries nnyaa real modirisi identity. word "modirisi" e latela puo ya motho go romelela kwa ntle. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Fa e tshubilwe, go romelela kwa ntle e boto emisetsa nngwe le nngwe e rometswe kwa ntle user's leina la modirisi, tletse leina le initials ka sebaledi placeholders (modirisi1, modirisi2,...), drops tsa bone setshwantsho sa motho, le rewrites @leina la modirisi mentions (le requested-by / assigned-by mafelo) mo teng karata le tlhaloso diteng. e rometswe kwa ntle faele carries nnyaa real modirisi identity. word "modirisi" e latela puo ya motho go romelela kwa ntle. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-activities-description: Fa e tshubilwe, activity-feed entries di le ka motlha rekotilwe le le ka motlha bontshitswe anywhere (boto bara ya letlhakore le karata tiragalo tab). Nnyaa hisetori ya who did eng ke kept. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-notifications-description: Fa e tshubilwe, WeKan le ka motlha sends lebelela dikitsiso (in-app, imeile kgotsa nngwe services) go le fa e le efe tiragalo. Ditiragalo ka kgona sa ntse nna rekotilwe (unless also e timilwe fa godimo); fela dikitsiso di suppressed. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-watch-description: Fa e tshubilwe, lebelela feature ke turned timilwe — badirisi ga e kgone subscribe go diboto, manane kgotsa dikarata go amogela dikitsiso, le le fa e le efe attempt go fetola e lebelela level ke rejected. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
backup-description: Morago up Dilo tse di tshwaraganeng, Ditshwantsho tsa batho le/kgotsa Tshedimosetso (tsotlhe text-based dikgobokanyo seo di ga dilo tse di tshwaraganeng kgotsa ditshwantsho tsa batho)..zip ke streamed directly go e tlhophilwe polokelo — nnyaa temporary faele — jaaka bekapo/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/bekapo.zip, e e nang le YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/dilo tse di tshwaraganeng, /ditshwantsho tsa batho le /tshedimosetso. Leru storages (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) dirisa dintlha tsa tetla configured mo tsa bone polokelo tabs.
backup-scope-description: whole tiragalo, kgotsa nngwe Mokgatlho. E Organization's bekapo e na le ya sona diboto le everything mo bone, including dilo tse di tshwaraganeng ya tseo diboto — but nnyaa modirisi diakhaonto le nnyaa tiragalo dithulaganyo, because tseo di aroganetswe ka nngwe le nngwe Mokgatlho. Restoring e Organization's bekapo fela ever writes go diboto seo Mokgatlho owns.

gcs-credentials-description: Boikgethelo: kgomaretsa tirelo akhaonto JSON senotlolo. Tlogela e lolea go dirisa senotlolo faele kgotsa ya tlwaelo dintlha tsa tetla.

Mo "Ntšhwa principals", kgomaretsa tirelo akhaonto imeile — "client_imeile" boleng go tswa ya gago JSON senotlolo — morago foo tlhopha maikarabelo "Polokelo Object Molaodi" le Boloka.

s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → ya gago setshelo leina (kgotsa Dira setshelo → Setshelo leina).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Badirisi → ya gago modirisi → Tshireletso dintlha tsa tetla → Tetla dinotlolo → Dira tetla senotlolo → tlhopha dirisa case 'Application e a tsamaya outside AWS' → Dira tetla senotlolo. Bontshitswe jaaka 'Tetla senotlolo ID'.

azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Kgoro → Polokelo diakhaonto → ya gago akhaonto → Tshireletso + networking → Tetla dinotlolo → senotlolo1 → Bontsha → Senotlolo.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Kgoro → Polokelo diakhaonto → ya gago akhaonto → Tshireletso + networking → Tetla dinotlolo → senotlolo1 → Kgokagano mokwalwa → Bontsha.

gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Leru Console → porojeke selector kwa godimo → ya gago project's ID (Leru overview → Dashboard → Porojeke tshedimosetso → Porojeke ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Leru Console → Leru Polokelo → Buckets → ya gago setshelo leina (kgotsa Dira go make nngwe).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Tsela mo WeKan seabi go downloaded tirelo akhaonto JSON senotlolo faele (e dirilwe fa tlase). Dirisa eno OR kgomaretsa JSON into lefelo fa tlase.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Leru Console → IAM & Molaodi → Tirelo diakhaonto → ya gago tirelo akhaonto → Dinotlolo → Tsenya senotlolo → Dira ntšhwa senotlolo → JSON → Dira (downloads faele). Kgomaretsa ya sona contents fano, kgotsa boloka faele le beakanya ya sona tsela fa godimo.
